# DrawDock Brand Kit v2 (radial-menu edition)

The coding-agent instructions are in `../SKILL.md`. This file is the human index.

## Palette
| Role | Hex |
|---|---|
| Deep navy (menu surface, background) | `#0B1B3A` |
| Navy surface (center button) | `#13284F` |
| Electric cyan (selection, active, toggles) | `#22D3EE` |
| Coral (brand ink accent) | `#FF6B57` |
| On-dark text/icons | `#E6F0FF` |
| Danger (Clear all) | `#FF5470` |
| Ink palette | Red `#EF4444` · Orange `#F97316` · Yellow `#FACC15` · Green `#22C55E` · Blue `#3B82F6` · Black `#111111` · White `#FFFFFF` |
| Blackboard | `#1F2B27` |

All tokens: `tokens/drawdock-tokens.json` (generated by `scripts/build_tokens.py`).

## Contents
- `icons/`: 48 icons covering every radial-menu root/submenu item, the center Close/Back and the connection controls. SVG sources; `drawdock-icon-sheet.png` is the preview. The v1 eraser, color-drop and generic draw icons were removed or renamed to match the PoC.
- `android/res/`: drop-in Android resources: `drawable/ic_dd_*.xml` VectorDrawables, `values/dd_colors.xml`, `dd_dimens.xml`, `dd_splash_theme.xml`, launcher mipmaps (including adaptive), and the Android 12 splash icon.
- `compose/DrawDockTokens.kt`: Jetpack Compose tokens.
- `mockups/`: exact renders of the radial menu (anatomy + 10 states) and the canvas visuals (selection handles, polygon construction, long-press ring), drawn at 3×.
- `logo/`: mark and horizontal logo for light and dark backgrounds, plus the wordmark.
- `app-icon/`: 1024 px master and 512 px Play Store icons.
- `splash/`: 10 portrait splash illustrations. `splash-03-radial-menu.png` (new) replaces the v1 tools image, which showed an eraser.
- `github/`: 1280×640 social preview (chips updated with "Radial pen menu"), plus a version without text.
